verdict.rationale: Thoropass documents a Monitors page that centralizes compliance monitor status and 'alerts you to compliance violations,' with drill-down to investigate violations, satisfying the core concept of failure/drift alerting with in-platform context. However there is no evidence that these alerts can be routed to Slack, email, or a ticketing system, nor that alerts carry enough remediation context outside the Thoropass UI. Missing for 10: documented Slack/email/ticketing notification channels for monitor alerts, evidence of contextual remediation guidance delivered via those channels, and any integration list confirming ticketing-system alerting.
